@graph.name: ZIVORA.ONE
@graph.description: ZIVORA.ONE helps businesses prepare their existing ERP, accounting, billing or invoicing software for UAE e-Invoicing. It works as a secure API connector between a business system and a UAE Accredited Service Provider, converting invoice data into the required PINT AE structured format, validating information and supporting electronic document exchange without replacing existing software.
featureList: API connector between ERP/accounting systems and UAE Accredited Service Providers
Conversion of invoice data to PINT AE XML structure
Compatible with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Odoo, Zoho, Sage, Infor, and custom ERPs
Support for B2B, B2G, export, credit note, and recurring invoices
ERP readiness assessment and data-gap analysis
Connects ERP, accounting, billing, and third-party applications

@graph.serviceType: UAE e-Invoicing Readiness Assessment and ERP API Integration
@graph.name: UAE e-Invoicing Readiness Assessment
@graph.description: A readiness and risk assessment that reviews a business's ERP, accounting or billing system to identify data and technical gaps before integrating UAE e-Invoicing via the ZIVORA.ONE API connector.

audience.audienceType: Businesses using SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Odoo, Zoho, Sage, Infor or custom ERP systems
